event.description: Use two learned final LayerNorm group scales
event.proposal: family: normalization; current retained incumbent is 2856 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0038, removing only the final LayerNorm bias at 3120/99.92%; same-family failed result: attempt-0056, replacing the 14-element final scale with one global scalar at 2871/5.47%. Prior attempts in this family: 8. Hypothesis: preserve full final LayerNorm normalization and retain channel-group calibration, but replace its 14 independent scale values with two learned scalars broadcast over the two 7-channel attention-head groups. This saves 12 parameters for a target of 2844 while providing more calibration capacity than the known one-scalar failure. This is more informative than retrying a global scalar or deleting scale, because it tests the nearest intermediate granularity and aligns the groups with the retained head-local attention organization. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, ff23 with one tied hidden unit per block, rank8 positions, affine-free block pre-norms, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2856 parameters.
